provenance: Generated locally with FFmpeg from two one-second constant-color lavfi sources; no third-party media. VP9 lossless,128x72,1fps. No runtime FFmpeg dependency.
commandTemplate: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=FIRST:s=128x72:r=1:d=1 -f lavfi -i color=c=SECOND:s=128x72:r=1:d=1 -filter_complex '[0:v][1:v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0' -c:v libvpx-vp9 -lossless 1 OUTPUT.webm
